title: Fourier coefficient of a finite sum
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\iota$ be a finite index set, let $f_i$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube for each $i\in\iota$, and let $S\subseteq[n]$. The Fourier coefficient at $S$ of $\sum_{i\in\iota} f_i$ is $\sum_{i\in\iota}\widehat{f_i}(S)$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ assigns a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube to each index in $\iota$
